messages:
Alice Gomez: Quick heads-up — PR opened for switching model configs from one giant ConfigMap to per-model ConfigMaps + TF changes. Need opinions on reload strategy and secrets handling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/compare/feat/per-model-configs

Ben Park: Why per-model instead of a single file? perf or size?

Alice Gomez: Mostly size (we hit the 1MB/64KB limits on large clusters) and safer rollouts. Having per-model CM lets us change one model without touching others. Also easier caching for runtime.

Carina Li: Important: k8s ConfigMap updates don't auto-restart processes. Are we planning to use a reloader sidecar or trigger rollouts?

Alice Gomez: Good call. I added the `model-config/reload: "stakater"` annotation to the ConfigMap and a matching annotation on the Deployment so stakater/reloader will mount changes and send SIGHUP. Snippet in PR:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-configs-{{MODEL_NAME}}
  annotations:
    model-config/reload: "stakater"
data:
  {{MODEL_NAME}}.json: |
    { "batch_size": 8, "quant": "int8" }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inference-{{MODEL_NAME}}
  annotations:
    reloader.stakater.com/match: "true"
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: inference
        model: {{MODEL_NAME}}
    containers:
    - name: runtime
      volumeMounts:
      - name: model-configs
        mountPath: /etc/model-configs
      args:
      - --model-config-path=/etc/model-configs/{{MODEL_NAME}}.json
```

Ben Park: CI plan failed on the TF side — provider wants to change the k8s IAM role for the node group. @Erik Novak did we expect that?

Erik Novak: Yeah, we added S3:GetObject permissions for the per-model config bootstrap (we store canonical configs in a customer bucket). Terraform will change the IRSA role. I'll run a `terraform plan` with the state move fix. Should be small.

DevBot: [staging] Deploy succeeded — inference/staging scaled to 6 pods (job 8821). :white_check_mark:

Farah Ahmed: Note on secrets: do NOT put model API keys in ConfigMaps. Use SealedSecrets or ExternalSecrets and mount as projected volume. If different models need different creds, keep them in Secrets named `model-secret-{{MODEL_NAME}}`. Also add RBAC so only model pods read their own secrets.

Gina Torres: Runtime FYI: I added `--model-config-path` support so runtime will prefer `/etc/model-configs/{{MODEL_NAME}}.json` and fall back to global config if missing. Also added a small validation on startup. PR 1769240001.

Ben Park: Can we canary config changes? say route 10% of traffic to pods using the new config before flipping?

Carina Li: Yes — we can label a subset of pods `model-canary=true` and have the router route a percentage to that label. Also you can do a deployment rollout with a label selector. We should add a canary playbook.

Alice Gomez: I'll update the PR with a canary section and add docs in infra playbook. Also adding notes to the runbook about the Stakater reloader and how to force a rollout: `kubectl rollout restart deploy -l model={{MODEL_NAME}}`

Ben Park: Sounds good. Ping me for review after you add the canary docs. :eyes:

Erik Novak: I'll coordinate the TF state work so CI can pass.

Farah Ahmed: I'll open a tiny RBAC PR template for per-model secret access.

Alice Gomez: Thanks all — will iterate. :shipit:
